import uno, time
from com.sun.star.connection import NoConnectException
local_ctx = uno.getComponentContext()
resolver = local_ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', local_ctx)
for i in range(5):
    try:
        ctx = resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext')
        print('connected')
        smgr=ctx.ServiceManager
        desktop=smgr.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx)
        comps=desktop.getComponents().createEnumeration()
        while comps.hasMoreElements():
            comp=comps.nextElement()
            print(comp, getattr(comp,'URL',None))
        break
    except Exception as e:
        print('try',i,e)
        time.sleep(1)
PY"

item.text: I can automate the open presentation. I’m going to place the audio object on slide 1 as a small media control/icon so it can be played during the introduction, then save the deck.

python3 - <<'PY'
import os, uno
from com.sun.star.awt import Point, Size
from com.sun.star.beans import PropertyValue

ppt = '/home/user/Desktop/Mady_and_Mia_Baseball.pptx'
mp3 = '/home/user/Desktop/Baseball.mp3'
ctx0 = uno.getComponentContext()
resolver = ctx0.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', ctx0)
ctx = resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext')
desktop = ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx)

doc = None
enum = desktop.getComponents().createEnumeration()
while enum.hasMoreElements():
    comp = enum.nextElement()
    if getattr(comp, 'URL', '') == uno.systemPathToFileUrl(ppt):
        doc = comp
        break
if doc is None:
    doc = desktop.loadComponentFromURL(uno.systemPathToFileUrl(ppt), '_blank', 0, ())

pages = doc.getDrawPages()
slide = pages.getByIndex(0)
# Remove any previous matching media object to keep this idempotent.
for i in range(slide.getCount() - 1, -1, -1):
    sh = slide.getByIndex(i)
    try:
        if sh.supportsService('com.sun.star.presentation.MediaShape') and sh.MediaURL.endswith('/Baseball.mp3'):
            slide.remove(sh)
    except Exception:
        pass

shape = doc.createInstance('com.sun.star.presentation.MediaShape')
# Presentation dimensions are in 1/100 mm. Put a small audio control near lower-right.
page_w = slide.Width
page_h = slide.Height
shape.setSize(Size(1700, 1200))
shape.setPosition(Point(page_w - 2300, page_h - 1650))
shape.MediaURL = uno.systemPathToFileUrl(mp3)
shape.MediaMimeType = 'audio/mpeg'
shape.Title = 'Baseball introduction audio'
shape.Description = 'Baseball.mp3'
try:
    shape.Loop = False
except Exception:
    pass
try:
    shape.Mute = False
except Exception:
    pass
slide.add(shape)

doc.store()
print('saved with audio shape on slide 1')
PY

from pathlib import Path
import zipfile, tempfile, shutil, os
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ppt = Path('/home/user/Desktop/Mady_and_Mia_Baseball.pptx')
mp3 = Path('/home/user/Desktop/Baseball.mp3')
backup = Path('/home/user/Desktop/Mady_and_Mia_Baseball.before-embed.pptx')
shutil.copy2(ppt, backup)

NS_REL = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'
NS_CT = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types'
NS_A = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'
NS_R = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
NS_P14 = 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS_REL)
ET.register_namespace('a', NS_A)
ET.register_namespace('r', NS_R)
ET.register_namespace('p14', NS_P14)
ET.register_namespace('p', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main')
ET.register_namespace('mc', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006')
ET.register_namespace('', NS_CT)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    root = Path(td)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(ppt, 'r') as zin:
        zin.extractall(root)

    media_dir = root / 'ppt' / 'media'
    media_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(mp3, media_dir / 'media1.mp3')

    # Content type for mp3 media.
    ct_path = root / '[Content_Types].xml'
    ct = ET.parse(ct_path)
    ct_root = ct.getroot()
    if not any(el.tag == f'{{{NS_CT}}}Default' and el.get('Extension') == 'mp3' for el in ct_root):
        ET.SubElement(ct_root, f'{{{NS_CT}}}Default', {'Extension': 'mp3', 'ContentType': 'audio/mpeg'})
    ct.write(ct_path, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

    # Convert LibreOffice's external media relationships to embedded package relationships.
    rels_path = root / 'ppt' / 'slides' / '_rels' / 'slide1.xml.rels'
    rels = ET.parse(rels_path)
    rel_root = rels.getroot()
    for rel in rel_root:
        rid = rel.get('Id')
        if rid == 'rId1':
            rel.set('Type', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/audio')
            rel.set('Target', '../media/media1.mp3')
            rel.attrib.pop('TargetMode', None)
        elif rid == 'rId2':
            rel.set('Type', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2007/relationships/media')
            rel.set('Target', '../media/media1.mp3')
            rel.attrib.pop('TargetMode', None)
    rels.write(rels_path, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

    # Mark the slide object as audio rather than video and point the Office 2010 media ref to embedded media.
    slide_path = root / 'ppt' / 'slides' / 'slide1.xml'
    slide = ET.parse(slide_path)
    sroot = slide.getroot()
    for vf in list(sroot.iter(f'{{{NS_A}}}videoFile')):
        vf.tag = f'{{{NS_A}}}audioFile'
    for media in sroot.iter(f'{{{NS_P14}}}media'):
        link_attr = f'{{{NS_R}}}link'
        embed_attr = f'{{{NS_R}}}embed'
        if link_attr in media.attrib:
            media.set(embed_attr, media.attrib.pop(link_attr))
    slide.write(slide_path, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

    tmp = ppt.with_suffix('.tmp.pptx')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for path in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
            if path.is_file():
                zout.write(path, path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
    tmp.replace(ppt)

print('embedded mp3 into pptx')
PY
